sources.scope: transactions from the 720 agencies in the Laforêt network, T1 2026
sources.limit: Network benchmark, not an exhaustive census of all French transactions.

facts: DVF contains transaction data from notarial deeds and cadastral information.
DVF does not contain the initial listing price.
DVF alone cannot measure the discount between listing and signed price.
Green value studies compare transaction prices by energy class.
Green value is not the negotiated discount between an advertisement and the signed sale.
An offer to purchase can bind its author if accepted.
No payment can be required from the buyer at the offer stage.
ANIL recommends a short response period in an offer.
ANIL recommends paying nothing before the preliminary contract.
A loan-financed purchase promise includes a financing condition.
The buyer must respect the financing parameters written into that condition.
The effort ratio is generally capped at 35 percent.
The maximum loan maturity is generally 25 years, with documented flexibility.
